description: Throw a stone into the sea from the steep pebble shore on the western edge of campus, where waves break on the shingle and gulls call, and see how it goes. Nothing is stored.

dog.description: Optional: bring the campus dog along (it lives at the doghouse; see visit_the_dog). Pass the name you gave it, or "yes".

name: throw_a_stone
title: Throw a stone at the waterfront
